description: Our group consists of people with heavy skills in coding, animation, graphic design, and video editing. We have the technical power to build anything from an animated video to an interactive web dashboard,  We aren't just here to participate; we want to collaborate deeply, create something genuinely beautiful, and push for a winning project. If you are passionate about space history and want a capable team that can execute your big ideas flawlessly, we highly encourage you to join us!
